mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.tempprocess.TempProcessMapper.getOrderPaymentListByParam */ SELECT OP.*, OPD.PG_SERVICE_TYPE, OPD.PG_SERVICE_MID, OPD.PG_SERVICE_KEY, OPD.PG_PAYMENT_TYPE, OPD.PG_KEY, OPD.PG_AUTH_CODE, OPD.PG_PROC_INFO, OPD.PART_CANCEL_FLAG, OPD.PART_CANCEL_DETAIL, OPD.PG_AMOUNT, OI.ORDER_STATUS, OI.ESCROW_STATUS, OI.ITEM_SEQUENCE FROM OP_ORDER_PAYMENT OP LEFT JOIN OP_ORDER_PG_DATA OPD ON OP.ORDER_PG_DATA_ID = OPD.ORDER_PG_DATA_ID INNER JOIN OP_ORDER_ITEM_HOLD OI ON OP.ORDER_CODE = OI.ORDER_CODE AND OP.ORDER_SEQUENCE = OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE WHERE OP.ORDER_CODE = #{orderCode} AND OP.ORDER_SEQUENCE = #{orderSequence} ORDER BY OP.PAYMENT_SEQUENCE ASC

/* saleson.shop.tempprocess.TempProcessMapper.getTempRemittanceInfoById */ SELECT R.REMITTANCE_ID , R.SELLER_ID , R.REMITTANCE_STATUS_CODE FROM OP_REMITTANCE R WHERE R.REMITTANCE_ID = #{remittanceId} AND R.REMITTANCE_STATUS_CODE = '0'
mapper.insert: /* saleson.shop.tempprocess.TempProcessMapper.insertHoldToOrderItem */ INSERT INTO OP_ORDER_ITEM SELECT * FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM_HOLD S WHERE 1=1 AND S.ORDER_CODE = #{orderCode} AND S.FILLER5 = #{filler5} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM T WHERE 1=1 AND T.ORDER_CODE = S.ORDER_CODE AND T.ORDER_SEQUENCE = S.ORDER_SEQUENCE AND T.ITEM_SEQUENCE = S.ITEM_SEQUENCE )

/* saleson.shop.tempprocess.TempProcessMapper.insertHoldToOrder */ INSERT INTO OP_ORDER SELECT * FROM MIG_OP_ORDER S WHERE 1=1 AND S.ORDER_CODE = #{orderCode} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE 1=1 AND OI.ORDER_CODE = S.ORDER_CODE AND OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE = S.ORDER_SEQUENCE ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OP_ORDER T WHERE 1=1 AND T.ORDER_CODE = S.ORDER_CODE AND T.ORDER_SEQUENCE = S.ORDER_SEQUENCE )

/* saleson.shop.tempprocess.TempProcessMapper.insertHoldToPayment */ INSERT INTO OP_ORDER_PAYMENT SELECT OI.ORDER_CODE ORDER_CODE , OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE ORDER_SEQUENCE , 0 PAYMENT_SEQUENCE , '1' PAYMENT_TYPE , 0 ORDER_PG_DATA_ID , 'give-point' APPROVAL_TYPE , MAX(OI.DEVICE_TYPE) DEVICE_TYPE , NULL CARD_EASY_TYPE , NULL BANK_VIRTUAL_NO , NULL BANK_IN_NAME , NULL BANK_DATE , SUM(OI.QUANTITY * OI.SALE_PRICE + OI.ETC_AMT) AMOUNT , 0 TAX_FREE_AMOUNT , SUM(CASE WHEN OI.ORDER_STATUS IN ('65', '75') THEN OI.QUANTITY * OI.SALE_PRICE + OI.ETC_AMT ELSE 0 END) CANCEL_AMOUNT , SUM(OI.QUANTITY * OI.SALE_PRICE + OI.ETC_AMT) - SUM(CASE WHEN OI.ORDER_STATUS IN ('65', '75') THEN OI.QUANTITY * OI.SALE_PRICE + OI.ETC_AMT ELSE 0 END) REMAINING_AMOUNT , MAX(OI.PAY_DATE) PAY_DATE , 'Y' NOW_PAYMENT_FLAG , MAX(OI.CREATED_DATE) CREATED_DATE , 'N' REFUND_FLAG , NULL PAYMENT_SUMMARY FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE 1=1 AND OI.ORDER_CODE = #{orderCode} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM OP_ORDER O WHERE O.ORDER_CODE = OI.ORDER_CODE ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM OP_ORDER_PAYMENT P WHERE 1=1 AND P.ORDER_CODE = OI.ORDER_CODE AND P.ORDER_SEQUENCE = OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE ) GROUP BY OI.ORDER_CODE, OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE

NVL(SUBSTR(MAX(REASON), 2,1), '6') FROM RC_ABS_STATE_LOG SLOG WHERE 1 = 1 AND SLOG.SERIAL_NUM = OI.FILLER5 AND SLOG.STATE = 'S' ) EXCHANGE_REASON -- 교환 사유코드 , (SELECT CASE WHEN NVL(SUBSTR(MAX(REASON), '배송중상품파손' WHEN NVL(SUBSTR(MAX(REASON), 2,1), '6') = '5' THEN '상품누락/오배송' ELSE '기타' END FROM RC_ABS_STATE_LOG SLOG WHERE 1 = 1 AND SLOG.SERIAL_NUM = OI.FILLER5 AND SLOG.STATE = 'S' ) EXCHANGE_REASON_TEXT -- 교환 사유 , (SELECT NVL(MAX(REASON_DESC), '') FROM RC_ABS_STATE_LOG SLOG WHERE 1 = 1 AND SLOG.SERIAL_NUM = OI.FILLER5 AND SLOG.STATE = 'S' ) EXCHANGE_REASON_DETAIL -- 교환 사유 상세 , '' OP_ORDER_SHIPPING_INFO SHIP WHERE 1=1 AND SHIP.ORDER_CODE = OI.ORDER_CODE AND SHIP.ORDER_SEQUENCE = OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE AND SHIP.SHIPPING_INFO_SEQUENCE = OI.SHIPPING_INFO_SEQUENCE AND SBAG.SBAG_SERIAL = OI.FILLER5 AND OI.ORDER_CODE = #{orderCode} AND OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE = #{orderSequence} AND OI.ITEM_SEQUENCE = #{itemSequence} AND OI.ORDER_STATUS IN ('50', '55', '58') -- 50:교환처리중 , 55: 교환배송중, 58:
